rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price sits below both session VWAP ($15.52) and the 9-EMA ($15.53) on a 5.68x relative-volume gap-down day, with a risk-off tape (SPY -0.25%, VIXY +1.04%) and failed bounce attempts stalling under VWAP on fading volume. Risk to the original $15.57 invalidation is only ~0.65% versus ~1% to the $15.31 target near the day's low, so the trade still offers acceptable asymmetry without adding risk. Flipping long would fight the prevailing intraday trend and negative market backdrop, and closing would forfeit a valid setup that has hit neither its stop nor its target.
